INSTRUCTIONS:
Is it going on the aircraft? If so, it needs to go into this sheet. 

Add a row in the relevant subassembly (or add a new subassembly) and then fill out that row according to the headers. Add the weight per item, the number of that item in the subassembly, and then how you sourced that weight. Leave your name in the "Sourced by" column and any notes you feel are applicable. Once the subassembly is complete and ready to go onto the aircraft, get your section lead or project lead to weigh the whole subassembly, and then fill out the "Subassembly weight override" which will allow us to track weight that cant be determined easily (like glue and bolts!). Once all those things have been completed, well done, your subassembly is now allowed to go onto the aircraft!

If you fail to do this the design team will find you, and will make you fill it out. Nothing absent from this sheet makes it onto the aircraft.
